t: Variant of the air of Campanone
d: There will be a cymbal, and a table with squid. A whistle, and all the chorists who try the music of the opera, don Grilletto.
Room in the house of the first woman, with cymbal, and music cards. On the one hand there will be a table with squid. Two practical doors. Corilla will come on stage all mixed, in Federico.
Don Cricket, and sayings.
Annoying, Violent, Whistle, all the Choirs, a Comparsa, which will bring the music, and sayings.
Bell in gala dress with sword, and purse, and sayings.
Annoyance, whistle, choristers, indi Campanone, and Don Grilletto.
Violant alone.
Corilla leaving the angry room, Frederick.
Campanone, it's called.
Don Crilletto, Disorder, and Whistle.
Annoying, and then Campanone.
Corilla, Federico, Don Grilletto, and sayings.
Annoying, and sayings.

Asena countryside with views of hills in distance, and curtains scattered here and there for the use of fair. Choir of Peasants, with peasants playing different instruments, indi Pipetto, and Checchinina.
Campanone, Federico, Don Grilletto, Fastidio. Corilla all frightened, leaning on Federico and Fastidio.
Choir of peasants and peasants returning; Pipet, Checchini, and sayings.
Variant extended to the beginning of scene five.
Atrium of the new theatre with big door in the middle that introduces to the audience. Café on one side, with People serving. Violant, Disorder, Whistle, who are taking coffee.
Federico, and Corilla.
The scene represents a new theater not entirely finished. On stage there will be People to work. Annoying, Violant, Whistle, all the Choirs, indi Campanone, Don Grilletto, Corilla and Federico.
Don Grilletto, and Campanone.
Federico, Corilla, Festidio and Violante returning, indi Campanone and Don Grilletto, reading a letter.
